editorialBrief.audience: Florida fans and families looking for a local match
editorialBrief.readerQuestion: Where can I watch professional women’s soccer outside Orlando?
editorialBrief.usefulOutcome: Compare three actual home grounds, find official tickets, and identify the Jacksonville home date.
editorialBrief.copyDirection: Normal full sentences; practical details; no fake experience, empty hype or repeated hook.

posts.caption:
Planning a match night in Florida? Start with these three clubs. We’ve included their home grounds, because Fort Lauderdale United’s stadium is actually in Davie.

Sporting JAX’s next home game is October 31 at 2 PM ET against Brooklyn. Tampa and FTL’s current schedules are linked below.

If you’ve been, where’s your favorite spot to watch from?

Schedules and tickets:

editorialBrief.audience: Parents near Winter Springs and Oviedo comparing first soccer programs
editorialBrief.readerQuestion: Which group fits my child, and will games involve travel?
editorialBrief.usefulOutcome: Know the U7–U8 and U9–U19 pathways, ask about away games, and find the current Spring waitlist instead of expired Fall registration.
editorialBrief.copyDirection: Specific parent questions, concise answers, current status. No invented family experience.

posts.caption:
Before signing a child up, ask where the games are. At Florida Kraze Krush, some recreational groups play other clubs and may travel to Cocoa or Ocala; others stay in-house.

These slides show the two age bands. Fall 2026 is closed. The recreational page now has a Spring 2027 registration link that starts on a waitlist.

Parents around Winter Springs and Oviedo: how much of a weekend drive works for your family?

Program details and birth-date charts:

https://floridakrazekrush.com/rec/
